quest.title: Concresoil
quest.description: Akim of Sumeru City seems to be having some new ideas regarding commonly used soils...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Isn't there a better material...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What material?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was talking to myself again. The fickle weather's been causing all sorts of problems with houses. I've never been this busy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you a potter?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Yeah, but I'm also a bricklayer. You see, it's all about the soil in either case. Not much of a difference.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Have you heard that saying? "Learning is like building a house. If you want to build a tall one, you must lay a solid foundation."

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: "And if you want to expand your knowledge, you need to ensure that your foundations are solid. A shifting foundation will only lead to collapse..."

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Those smart higher-ups always say so. I don't really get it, but it's clear to me that they regard building houses to be as important as learning!

choices.text: They're just using a figure of speech...

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Anyway, when you think of a house's foundations, you think of building materials.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Soil is the binding and support material, so if its stability and adaptability can be increased, our houses will be more durable. And I won't have to be this busy anymore.

choices.text: I don't think that's how you interpret it.

talks.objective: Go to the place Akim recommended

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I've come up with a few ideas, and today, I'm planning to find some soil soaked in Slime Condensate.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I've found out about a place where Slimes gather. Can you head there and find me some soil?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I'll leave it to you then. It doesn't matter if you take those Slimes down or not. Just bring some of the soil near them back.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I'll mark the place on the map for you...

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I would love to, but I still have some pottery to handle.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Don't worry. I'll take care of the payment. Thanks a lot!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I'll mark the place on the map for you, so please head there and look for it.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I've come up with a few ideas, and today... I'm planning to find some soil that is constantly exposed to elemental creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Whopperflowers will be a good option. The soil where such creatures grow may have distinctive features.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: But I'm just a bricklayer, and well, hitting Whopperflowers with a brick is hardly going to help me get a hold of that soil...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, could you help me do this?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Thank you. And don't forget, we're looking for soil where Whopperflowers grow!

response.speaker: Akim

dialogues.text: I've come up with a few ideas, and I'm planning to find some moist soil today.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: With adequate moisture and strong adhesion, it should be perfect for fixing cracks.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: It would be great if you could help. I will mark the location on your map. Please go look for it...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Have you found the soil that I need?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I want. You're a great help!

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: This soil is sticky to the touch. Is this because there's some Slime Condensate mixed in it? I wonder if this can be mixed together with other soil types...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for your help, and please take your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Oh, perhaps we should call it "Concresoil" or something...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: This is exactly what I'm looking for. You're a great help! I'll start some experiments with this later.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Please take this as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: If I can mix different soils together, will the mixture be more durable...?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Yes, this is exactly what I want. You're a great help!

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's softer than I expected. The adhesion is fine, but it doesn't provide enough support...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: It's okay, though. As those wise folk put it, "No tall building was built in a day."

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I suppose creating the kind of soil I want couldn't be that easy either...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I'll try some other options later.

dialogues.text: Let's go dig some soil out, shall we?
